safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold which states 'No pain' (Generated asserts painful).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting the condition as painful when the gold record states no pain can inflate perceived severity and may drive unnecessary escalation (e.g., stronger therapy, more urgent follow-up), but is unlikely to cause major harm in an uncomplicated hand dermatitis presentation.

Incorrectly recording that the patient has allergies when the gold record is NKDA can lead to avoidance of first-line medications, delays in prescribing, or selection of less appropriate alternatives; allergy documentation errors are higher-risk because they directly affect medication safety decisions.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold which documents no fever.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating fever is present when it is not can incorrectly suggest infection/systemic illness, potentially prompting unnecessary investigations, antibiotics, or escalation of care; fever is a red-flag symptom that meaningfully changes clinical decision-making.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold which documents no urinary symptoms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Incorrectly documenting urinary symptoms can misdirect the assessment toward UTI or other urinary pathology, leading to potentially unnecessary testing or treatment, though it is less directly harmful than medication/allergy errors.
